content.title: The Impact of New Media Investor Sentiment on the Price Fluctuations of Domestic Stocks
content.abstract: With the deep integration of new media into the capital market, stock forums and financial forums have become important channels for individual investors to obtain information and exchange views. The impact of new media investor sentiment on stock price fluctuations has also become an important research topic in behavioral finance. Retail investors hold a significant proportion in the A-share market, making individual investors easily influenced by public sentiment. Abnormal stock price fluctuations induced by public sentiment pose a real challenge to market stability. This paper systematicall
